decisions.reason: Removing Aave yield does not remove the prize pools or the requirement to publish their values through public APIs.
Prize delivery remains an automatic wallet transfer regardless of whether prize-pool deposits earn Aave yield.
Removing the pool-yield provider does not change Chainlink VRF selection, ticket weighting, or on-chain verification.
The source removes only Aave integration; it does not cancel or modify the Big Block prize amount, trigger, funding, or ticket rules.
The source removes only Aave integration; the Small Block prize amount, draw interval, funding, and ticket rules remain unchanged.
The candidate state contains no current Aave or yield-generation FAQ attribute to remove, and its existing prize-pool descriptions remain valid.
Random ticket allocation for mints without referral codes is independent of whether prize-pool deposits accrue yield.
The automatic $5 referral commission does not depend on the removed Aave prize-pool yield integration.
Referral-triggered Small and Big Block ticket issuance and ticket cycles remain valid without Aave yield.
Removing Aave does not remove the prize pools as revenue destinations or change the mint price, founder share, or commission allocation.
Small and Big Block ticket counters and their post-draw resets are independent of prize-pool yield generation.
Removing Aave yield does not change winner announcements or dashboard and email notification channels.
